brief:
More than 1,500 Palestinians have been displaced in the Jordan Valley since the start of the year by Israeli settler violence and demolitions, Eye on Palestine reported. The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs cited demolitions carried out under the pretext of lacking Israeli building permits as a primary cause of displacement.

The Jordan Valley, located in the occupied West Bank, has long been a flashpoint for Palestinian-Israeli tensions over settlement expansion and land disputes.
